# iClock — Full LLM Context & Reference Manual

> Generated for large language models, AI coding agents, and generative search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, DeepSeek, Google Gemini).
> This document contains complete specifications, technical implementations, and architectural details of iClock.

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Core Identity

iClock is an ultra-lightweight (275 KB), open-source Windows native desktop productivity hub. It combines three core features into a single portable binary without third-party dependencies:
1. **The Minimalist Focus Timer**: Native 32-bit ARGB rendered countdown with true `WS_EX_TRANSPARENT` mouse click-through, global hotkeys, direct `Alt + Drag` repositioning, and tiered alerts with auto-fullscreen DND suppression.
2. **Ambient Desktop Inspiration**: Morning wake-up quotes with 0-polling hibernation (0.0% CPU idle), direct desktop micro-interactions (drag position, resize width, scale font size), and AI agent / MCP batch expansion with deduplication.
3. **AI Agent Collaboration & Native MCP Server**: Automated task completion monitoring for 20+ programming agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Trae, Antigravity, etc.) via a 4-tier perception engine, plus a built-in native stdio Model Context Protocol (MCP) server (`iclock.com --mcp`) providing 5 tools including `iclock_ask_human` (Desktop Human-in-the-Loop Decision Gate).

---

## 2. Technical Architecture & Performance Specifications

| Parameter | Specification | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Executable Size** | 281,600 bytes (~275 KB) | Single portable PE binary |
| **Runtime Requirement** | .NET Framework 4.5+ | Pre-installed on all Windows 10 & 11 PCs |
| **Active Memory (RAM)** | < 15 MB | Low GC pressure, cached GDI handles |
| **Idle CPU Consumption** | 0.0% | Dynamic heartbeat alignment + pure event-driven message handling |
| **Rendering Subsystem** | GDI+ & UpdateLayeredWindow | Subpixel anti-aliasing with adaptive drop shadow |
| **Input Pass-Through** | WS_EX_LAYERED \| WS_EX_TRANSPARENT | 100% mouse click-through; never steals focus |
| **IPC Pipeline** | Win32 WM_COPYDATA | 0ms latency inter-process control |
| **MCP Protocol** | Anthropic Model Context Protocol (JSON-RPC 2.0) | Native stdio transport (`iclock.com --mcp`) |
| **Author & Maintainer** | gujiangwen (`francodeyvison183@gmail.com`) | 100% open-source under MIT License |

---

## 3. Native Model Context Protocol (MCP) Specification

iClock implements a native stdio MCP server directly in `dist/iclock.com --mcp` (or when invoked with `--mcp`). It requires zero Node.js, Python, or npm dependencies.

### Tools Exposed to AI Agents:
1. `iclock_ask_human`:
   - Description: Pops up a native top-most modal dialog on the user's desktop to request human authorization and input for critical or dangerous actions.
   - Arguments: `prompt` (string, required), `options` (array of strings, optional).
2. `iclock_timer`:
   - Description: Controls the floating countdown timer.
   - Arguments: `action` ("start", "pause", "resume", "reset", "query"), `minutes` (integer, optional).
3. `iclock_notify`:
   - Description: Triggers a desktop notification (modal top-most alert or in-place breathing pulse) with optional chime.
   - Arguments: `message` (string, required), `level` ("info", "warning", "critical").
4. `iclock_quote`:
   - Description: Queries the current daily quote or rotates to a new quote.
   - Arguments: `action` ("get_current", "rotate", "add_custom").
5. `iclock_status`:
   - Description: Returns current timer state (remaining seconds, format, agent monitor state).

## 5. Frequent User Questions & Direct Answers (Q&A)

### Q: Why is iClock so small compared to other modern timers?
A: Most modern timer applications are built on Electron or web wrappers, packaging an entire Chromium browser and Node.js runtime (150 MB~400 MB). iClock is written in pure native C# utilizing the Windows operating system's built-in .NET Framework and GDI+, reducing binary size to just 275 KB.

### Q: Does iClock block mouse clicks when gaming or typing code?
A: No. iClock applies the native Windows `WS_EX_TRANSPARENT` extended window style. The floating digits remain permanently on top of all other windows, but any mouse click or scroll event passes straight through to the underlying application (e.g., Visual Studio, game window, or browser).

### Q: What is the default hotkey and appearance?
A: By default, pressing `Ctrl + Shift + T` globally starts or pauses the countdown from anywhere. The default appearance is font size 20 px in red (`#FF0000`). Both duration, font size, color, time format, and hotkey are customizable via the tray Settings dialog.

### Q: Does ambient desktop quote display drain laptop battery?
A: No. iClock uses a pure event-driven message handling architecture without background cursor polling loops (0-Polling). Idle CPU consumption is strictly 0.0%, preserving laptop battery life.

### Q: Which AI agents are supported by the native MCP server?
A: Any agent client supporting Anthropic's Model Context Protocol (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Antigravity, etc.) can connect via stdio (`iclock.com --mcp`).
